title: Probing the Origins of Reasoning Performance: Representational Quality for Mathematical Problem-Solving in RL vs. SFT Fine-Tuned Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.26119v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to reason step by step have been increasingly shown to outperform their supervised fine-tuned (SFT) counterparts on mathematical reasoning tasks. Yet the mechanistic basis for this improvement remains unclear. We therefore ask, what internal representational differences enable RL-trained reasoning language models to reason better? Our work presents two primary lines of evidence: First, layer-wise linear probes tend to predict answer correctness more accurately in RL-trained reasoning language models than in instruction-tuned models on synthetic math problems, although output length alone matches the DeepSeek-Math-RL probe on two templates. Second, mean ablation studies suggest that accuracy drop rises with layer depth in DeepSeek-Math-RL but not in DeepSeek-Math-Instruct. translated_title: 探究推理性能的起源：强化学习与监督微调模型在数学问题求解中的表征质量
translated_abstract: 通过强化学习（RL）训练以逐步推理的大型语言模型，已被越来越多地证明在数学推理任务上优于其监督微调（SFT）的对应模型。然而，这种性能提升的机制基础仍不清楚。因此，我们提出这样的问题：RL训练的推理语言模型凭借怎样的内部表征差异而能更好地进行推理？我们的工作提供了两条主要证据线：首先，在合成数学问题上，逐层线性探针在RL训练的推理语言模型中预测答案正确性的准确度往往高于指令微调模型，尽管仅凭输出长度这一因素就能在两个模板上达到与DeepSeek-Math-RL探针相当的预测效果。其次，均值消融研究表明，在DeepSeek-Math-RL中准确率下降随层深度的增加而上升，但在DeepSeek-Math-Instruct中并非如此。最后，我们分析了RL训练的推理语言模型在不同准确率区间上的token数量变异性……
tldr: 本研究通过逐层线性探针和均值消融实验揭示，RL训练的推理语言模型内部具有更高质量、更易线性解码出答案正确性的表征，且其深层表征对消融更敏感，从而为RL在数学推理上优于SFT提供了机制层面的解释。
